drills.injection: Stop alloy.service after scheduling an independent systemd recovery.
drills.recovery: Start alloy.service and require the local readiness endpoint to return healthy.

drills.injection: Stop the managed textfile timer and atomically age only its collector-success timestamp.
drills.recovery: Run the managed collector, restore the timer, and require a fresh success timestamp.

drills.injection: Invoke the backend protected worker-unavailable fixture for one exact shadow worker.
drills.recovery: Remove the fixture, restore the exact worker, and require readiness plus scrape freshness.

drills.injection: Emit the bounded telemetry-only zero-consumer fixture without calling RabbitMQ, stopping a consumer, or changing a queue.
drills.recovery: Emit the exact fixture inactive state and require unchanged real RabbitMQ consumer telemetry.

drills.injection: Emit the bounded telemetry-only DLQ rule-path fixture without publishing, consuming, or deleting any RabbitMQ message.
drills.recovery: Emit the exact fixture inactive state and require unchanged real RabbitMQ queue telemetry.

drills.injection: Emit the bounded telemetry-only relay-lag rule-path fixture without pausing or changing replication.
drills.recovery: Emit the exact fixture inactive state, require unchanged relay configuration, and check real relay health only when the relay is configured.

drills.injection: Invoke the backend readiness failure fixture without changing the compatibility API route.
drills.recovery: Remove the fixture and require process, PostgreSQL, and public readiness checks to pass.

drills.injection: Save the complete selected remote check, mutate one assertion family, and prove a controlled probe failure.
drills.recovery: Restore the complete saved check representation and prove both public probes recover.
